name: thermal-printer
description: Print lists, labels, notes, barcodes, QR codes and images on an ESC/POS thermal receipt or label printer. Claude composes each print from simple building blocks, checks it against your paper, then sends it over the network or USB.

printer.title: Printer connection (optional)
printer.description: How to reach the printer: tcp://192.168.1.50:9100 for a network printer, cups:<queue name> for a USB printer set up in CUPS, or a device path like /dev/usb/lp0. Leave blank and Claude will help you find it.
